Package sootup.core.types

Class Type

java.lang.Object
sootup.core.types.Type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Acceptor<TypeVisitor>
Direct Known Subclasses:
BottomType, PrimitiveType, ReferenceType, TopType, UnknownType, VoidType
public abstract class Type extends Object implements Acceptor<TypeVisitor>
Represents the signature of a Java type, e.g., a class, a primitive type, void, or null.
